questions.question: How does Isaiah 60 begin?
options: 'Weep and mourn, for the day is dark'
'Return to me, and I will return to you'
'Be still, and know that I am God'
'Arise, shine, for your light has come'
questions.answer: 'Arise, shine, for your light has come'

questions.question: What will the nations and kings come to in Isaiah 60?
options: Zion's light and the brightness of her rising
The throne of David, restored in glory
The walls of the city, rebuilt with stone
The wealth of Egypt and the gold of Sheba
questions.answer: Zion's light and the brightness of her rising

questions.question: Isaiah 60 says the LORD will be Zion's everlasting light, and her days of mourning shall be ended.
Arise, _____, for your light has come, and the glory of the LORD has risen upon you.
The LORD will be your everlasting _____, and your God will be your glory.
